purpose: 315 ORIGINAL NativeZipper complete eight-tape seed initializations,all source words of lengths0..5 and16 larger words at lengths8,16,32,64;C=0,1,4,16,excluding the zero-width case. Initial source is marked,seven work tapes blank. Check halt,all literal tape contents/START/STOP,all eight distinct signed absolute head positions,common widths and numeric values. Expected tapes are specified independently of ArithmeticSeed.ready. No free dimension extraction or row-operand computation is claimed.
source:
import TransposeFollowup.ArithmeticSeedRun
open TransposeFollowup FixedTapeCompiler CopyMachine

def bits (m n : Nat) : List Bool := (List.range m).map n.testBit

def words : List (List Bool) :=
  (List.range 6).flatMap (fun m => (List.range (2^m)).map (bits m)) ++
  [8,16,32,64].flatMap (fun m => [0,1,2^m-1,2^(m-1)+5].map (bits m))

def positions : ArithmeticSeed.Port → Int
  | .source => -31 | .number => 17 | .zeroA => -100 | .zeroB => 200
  | .one => -7 | .fuel => 43 | .left => 0 | .right => -1024

def allPorts : List ArithmeticSeed.Port :=
  [.source,.number,.zeroA,.zeroB,.one,.fuel,.left,.right]

def checkSeed (C : Nat) (xs : List Bool) : Bool :=
  let m := 2*xs.length+C
  let c := NativeZipper.run (ArithmeticSeed.program C) (46*xs.length+17*C+81)
    (ArithmeticSeed.zipperCfg (.pad false (.init (.erase 0))) (ArithmeticSeed.initial xs) positions)
  let number := xs ++ List.replicate (xs.length+C) false
  let zeroWord := List.replicate m false
  let oneWord := true :: List.replicate (m-1) false
  let expected : ArithmeticSeed.Port → Tape Bool := fun p => match p with
    | .source => Counter.marked xs
    | .number => Counter.marked number
    | .zeroA | .zeroB => Counter.marked zeroWord
    | .one => Counter.marked oneWord
    | .fuel => Counter.marked [true]
    | .left | .right => ⟨[.start],[]⟩
  decide (c.core.pc = .done) &&
    allPorts.all (fun p => decide (c.core.tapes p = expected p) && decide (c.pos p = positions p)) &&
    decide (number.length = m) && decide (zeroWord.length = m) && decide (oneWord.length = m) &&
    decide (Counter.value number = Counter.value xs) && decide (Counter.value zeroWord = 0) &&
    decide (Counter.value oneWord = 1)

def seedChecks : Nat × Nat := Id.run do
  let mut checked := 0
  let mut failures := 0
  for xs in words do
    for C in [0,1,4,16] do
      if 0 < 2*xs.length+C then
        checked := checked+1
        if !checkSeed C xs then failures := failures+1
  return (checked,failures)
#eval seedChecks
